Australia. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Steve Backshall: The Vertical Mile – Face to Face with the Mountain | E01
programme.desc: The north face of the Eiger Mountain is the most famous peak in the history of extreme mountaineering. It is 3,970 m high and, despite its relatively low height, gives chills to the best climbers in the world. It is called After months of preparation, Steve Backshall and the best alpinists go to Switzerland to conquer one of the most famous peaks in the history of climbing - the Eiger. The team quickly discovers that. 2018. documentary film

programme.title: Steve Backshall: Vertical Mile – On the Edge | E02
programme.desc: The north face of the Eiger Mountain is the most famous peak in the history of extreme mountaineering. It is 3,970 m high and, despite its relatively low height, gives chills to the best climbers in the world. Her name is Steve Backshall and her team conquer the peak of Mount Eiger, one of the most dangerous in the world. Blinding blizzards, ice covering the rocks, bitter cold, physical exhaustion and an approaching storm force the group to race against time to save the expedition. 2018. documentary film

programme.title: Ice Vikings – Season of Thick Ice | S01E02
programme.desc: The series shows viewers what the struggles of ice Viking teams look like during winter fishing. While performing their work, crews often have to deal with cold and numerous problems. The temperature is decreasing every moment, meanwhile fishermen are doing everything to catch the most valuable fish species. The task is not easy because the entire lake is covered with ice, which causes additional problems. Canada. 2020. documentary series

programme.title: Ice Vikings – New Toy | S01E03
programme.desc: The series shows viewers what the struggles of ice Viking teams look like during winter fishing. While performing their work, crews often have to deal with cold and numerous problems. Chris Kristjanson comes into possession of a house wagon that belonged to his father years ago. However, the man has no intention of using it. The Husavik team tries to catch some prey. It turns out to be more difficult than they expected. Canada. 2020. documentary series

programme.title: Ice Vikings – Crashes and Problems | S01E04
programme.desc: The series shows viewers what the struggles of ice Viking teams look like during winter fishing. While performing their work, crews often have to deal with cold and numerous problems. Trevor and Chris Kristjanson need to repair their vehicles. Justin and Mike go to Hecla Island. They hope that fishing there will be much more abundant. Canada. 2020. documentary series

programme.title: Ice Vikings – Moving Ice | S01E05
programme.desc: The series shows viewers what the struggles of ice Viking teams look like during winter fishing. While performing their work, crews often have to deal with cold and numerous problems. programme.title: Ice Vikings – Escape from the Ice | S01E08
programme.desc: The series shows viewers what the struggles of ice Viking teams look like during winter fishing. While performing their work, crews often have to deal with cold and numerous problems. Chris receives a call from a sick fisherman. The weather improves and a large wall of ice forms on the lake. This phenomenon worries all teams. Canada. 2020. documentary series

programme.title: Brotherhood of Lions - The way to the top | E01
programme.desc: The life story of young lions. The everyday challenges they have to face throughout their adolescence will be shown. Triumphant moments after hunting will be presented, as well as the dangers they are exposed to. The hunting process of young lions will be presented, as well as the discovery of new areas. The camera also captures conflicts between them, when the mother returns to her children with a new offspring. Germany. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Planet of Sharks – Ocean Wanderer | S01E02
programme.desc: Scientists use modern technologies to monitor the underwater life of various species of sharks. These cartilaginous fish are completely unjustifiably associated with bloodthirsty predators. They hunt intelligently, using their keen senses and developed hunting instincts. Viewers will see, among others: how a whitetip shark senses the heartbeat of its prey. Sharks have lived on Earth since before the age of dinosaurs - they have been roaming the oceans for over 400 million years. Only today are scientists beginning to discover the secrets of their evolutionary success. USA. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Dzika Kanada – Lato | S01E02
programme.desc: Four beautifully filmed and well-edited episodes that show the history of the part of North America that lies beyond the Arctic Circle. The documentary uses incredible aerial photography and astonishing time-lapse footage. They cover areas from the east coast to the west, from the plains to the wilderness, from vast expanses of grassy prairies to the cold, lifeless landscapes of the Arctic. This is the beating heart of true wild Canada. Viewers will be able to admire Canadian landscapes in full summer bloom. Orcas and blue sharks will go hunting, and the forest will be illuminated by charming fireflies. USA, Great Britain, Austria, Canada. 2014. documentary series

programme.title: Nile: the final river – Mountains of the Moon | E01
programme.desc: Researchers present extraordinary places located in the Nile Delta. They visit, among others: Lake Victoria and the Semien Mountains to look at the local fauna and flora. Documentarians go on a journey through areas related to the Upper Nile. They present the flora of the Rwenzori mountain range and observe the yellow-sided nectaries living in this region. They also visit the Nyungwe Forest National Park, which is inhabited by numerous representatives of primates, including: chimpanzees and Angolan gerees. They also stop at Lake Victoria to capture the extraordinary chironomid mating dance. Austria. 2014. documentary film

programme.title: Wild Slovakia with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: The mountains in Slovakia are filled with fairy-tale castles overlooking the Danube. Wolves, lynxes, over 1,500 brown bears, and many other species live in their areas... Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Snow creatures
programme.desc: Animals must have a variety of tactics prepared to survive in one of the coldest places on our planet. From finding a convenient place to hunt to a shelter where they can raise their offspring. Nature film presenter Liz Bonnin will show viewers how animals cope in such difficult conditions... Great Britain. 2019. documentary film

programme.title: Year on Earth – Spring | E02
programme.desc: The authors observe changes in ecosystems in various places on the Earth's surface. The rhythm of these changes is determined by the movement of the Blue Planet around the Sun. In March, the northern hemisphere begins to be better illuminated. The air temperature is rising, the snow is melting, and nature is awakening to new life. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Gladiators of the animal world – Waterhole | E01
programme.desc: Some animals have a predisposition to fighting and facing enemies. With deadly weapons, cunning and tactics, they are born warriors of this world. Drought forces animals to meet at a watering hole in southern Africa. This means that large and small species must live dangerously close to each other. Australia. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Lion Rules – Hide and Seek | E03
programme.desc: In the floodplains of the lower reaches of the African Kuando River, called Chobe, a pride of lions dominates the local ecosystem. The clan, consisting of a dozen or so individuals, is ruled by two brothers and a brave female. The rebellious young lion Einstein stands out from them. Even though he should leave the family herd, he stubbornly sticks to his loved ones. With the arrival of the dry season, lions start fighting for survival. They try to protect their territory and offspring from rivals. When the cubs appear, Einstein decides to leave for good and start a new life. During the rainy season, the vegetation turns green rapidly, making it difficult for the lions to camouflage. Einstein tries to make new bonds, but he finds it very difficult. Mad-Eye Moody kidnaps Keeza and her pup. South Africa. 2025. nature series

programme.title: Sharks vs. killer whales
programme.desc: The great white shark is not at the top of the food chain. His power means he could be on it. However, killer whale attacks made them the kings of the oceans. The creators will take a look at these majestic creatures and wonder if sharks have any chance against them... Great Britain. 2025. documentary film

programme.title: Earth – planet of life – Earth – snowball | E02
programme.desc: Earth has survived countless collisions and disasters in the solar system. From asteroid impacts to volcanic eruptions and climate crises. The program will show what some of them looked like... Germany. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School: Bald is Beautiful (S2E6). Documentary about nature. England, 2019. S2, Ep6
programme.desc: 2019 г. Год: 2019. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2019. S2, Ep6 «Orangutan Jungle School»…After a terrible accident at the nursery forest school, life changes drastically for nine-month-old Alejandra. And at forest school, the students enjoy a poolside classroom where Valentino proves he's much more than just a class clown | Captivating documentary series that follows the work of the Nyaru Menteng Orangutan Rescue Centre in Borneo, Indonesia, which is the largest orangutan rehabilitation centre in the world. People who work here are dedicated to rescuing orangutans that have been displaced from their habitat or kept as illegal pets, and they do their best to help them adjust and teach them the skills necessary to survive on their own when they return to the jungle. Hear some incredible stories and follow the antics, triumphs and tragedies of a group of orphaned orangutans as they go through «Orangutan Jungle School» | Director: Judith Curran | Cast: Rebecca Parr

programme.title: Arctic Secrets: Rhythm of the Bay (S2E1). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Kanada, 2017. S2, Ep1
programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2017. S2, Ep1 «Arctic Secrets»…The Hudson Bay lowlands are part of North America's largest wetland. Over 300,000 square kilometers of muskeg, a vast bogland as far as the eye can see characterized by water soaked peat, mosses and stunted trees. Once thought of as barren wasteland, it is now understood that these bogs are crucially important to life on earth. Globally, there is as much carbon dioxide held in wetlands as there is in the atmosphere. The peatland ecosystem is the most efficient carbon sink on the planet | With its vast expanses of pristine white snow and clear glacial waters the landscapes of the Arctic are truly stunning, But, don't be fooled, for those who must live in this demanding environment, it is far from a winter wonderland. This documentary series takes a look at the people and animals for whom the Arctic is home. We see how Inuit tribes, orcas, polar bears and more survive the challenges of living in the severe climate of the northernmost part of our planet. The tribes and species of the Arctic have spent thousands of years learning how to adapt to the change of the seasons. They must now adapt to a new threat; the impact of climate change | Director: Allan Code

programme.title: d/s Sharks. Declaration of love. 2 s.
programme.desc: Sharks are the oldest inhabitants of the ocean, having survived millions of years of evolution and retained their uniqueness to this day. We learn about the different species of sharks, their anatomy, behavior and ecology. Experts will talk about the myths and facts associated with these predators, dispelling many common misconceptions

programme.title: d/s Esteros Nature Reserve in focus. How I see Esteros del Ibera
programme.desc: Esteros del Ibera is one of the largest natural reserves in Argentina, known for its rich ecosystem and picturesque landscapes. Six photographers travel to this unique location to take part in the first reality show to combine the art of photography and wildlife. 2015

programme.title: d/s Esteros Nature Reserve in focus. Grand final
programme.desc: Esteros del Ibera is one of the largest natural reserves in Argentina, known for its rich ecosystem and picturesque landscapes. Six photographers travel to this unique location to take part in the first reality show to combine the art of photography and wildlife. 2015

programme.title: d/s On the seabed. 1 p.
programme.desc: In this project you will meet great white sharks, colorful cuttlefish and playful sea lions. From mysterious jellyfish and shy squid to giant whales and cunning octopuses, we explore the amazing stories of survival and evolution of marine inhabitants, their interaction in the ocean environment. 2021

programme.title: d/s Strategies in the wild. Winning Strategies
programme.desc: In the wild, the ability to win fights is an essential factor. Fighting strategies, known as agonistic, can be used by animals to maintain a hierarchy, provide themselves with resources, seize territories, and find a mate. Dir.: Bettina Dalton, Max Serio. Czech Republic, USA, 2016

programme.title: d/s Living Nature. Lakes. Mysterious mirrors
programme.desc: The source of inspiration for the authors of the series was the nature around us - the variety of landscapes, reservoirs, forests, fields, deserts and the animals that inhabit them. But at the same time, with stunning filming and admiration for the diversity of our planet, they are trying to convey to us the idea of ​​how fragile and vulnerable this world is. Director: Igor Falelyukhin. Russia, 2024

programme.title: d/s Living Nature. Forests. Lungs of our planet
programme.desc: The source of inspiration for the authors of the series was the nature around us - the variety of landscapes, reservoirs, forests, fields, deserts and the animals that inhabit them. programme.title: d/s Amazing animal families. 7 p.
programme.desc: Pygmy seahorses like to “decorate” themselves so that they are not noticed by their enemies. Leopard cubs, on the other hand, prefer to fight whenever possible. Australia, 2019

programme.title: d/f Guadeloupe: mountains and ocean
programme.desc: Among the crystal clear waters of the Caribbean Sea lies the amazing land of Guadeloupe. From island peaks to lush forests, past rivers, marshes, beaches and mangroves, the variety of landscapes and ecosystems here is amazing. Enjoy the beauty and grandeur of wild nature with us! France, 2019

programme.title: d/s Galapagos. At the edge of the Earth. Two-Faced Ocean
programme.desc: The surrounding world of the deep waters of the Pacific Ocean also has its own peculiarity and significance. The variety of fish species and other sea creatures makes it attractive to snorkelers and divers. Dir.: Chan Won-joon. South Korea, 2018

programme.title: d/s Race of life. Protection of underwater inhabitants
programme.desc: In order to protect themselves and survive, aquatic animals have to resort to unimaginable tricks and use different strategies. Czech Republic, USA, 2015

programme.title: d/s Race of life. Racing under your feet
programme.desc: There are many reasons why insects survive, from flexible shells to wings that allow them to fly away from danger. Czech Republic, USA, 2015

programme.title: d/f Australia: a journey through evolution
programme.desc: As a result of Australia's separation from the main continent millions of years ago, the island became isolated by the ocean. Due to this special location of the mainland and its remoteness from other lands, as well as the wide variety of weather conditions, Australia developed its own, very special ecosystem, which evolved over many billions of years. The film tells about the changes that Australia's wildlife has undergone over the course of 35 million years. Spain, 2014

programme.title: d/s Kingdom of the Big Panda. Birth of a Giant
programme.desc: Giant pandas are not only a national treasure of China, but also beloved animals around the world. The series will provide unique footage of the daily lives of two panda families living in a nature reserve in southwest China where human presence is kept to a minimum. We will follow the lives of adorable bamboo bears from birth to adulthood. France, 2006

programme.title: d/s Kingdom of the Big Panda. Freedom training
programme.desc: Giant pandas are not only a national treasure of China, but also beloved animals around the world. The series will provide unique footage of the daily lives of two panda families living in a nature reserve in southwest China where human presence is kept to a minimum. We will follow the lives of adorable bamboo bears from birth to adulthood. France, 2006

programme.title: d/f Wild Caribbean
programme.desc: The Caribbean archipelago is a chain of islands containing unique specimens of wildlife. Life took hold in this isolated environment, carried by winds, migrating birds or sea waves. programme.desc: Julia Zemirio tới Công viên Quốc gia Uluru-Kata Tjuta trong hành trình đến trái tim thiêng liêng của nước Úc để khám phá tầm quan trọng mà người Úc bản địa và không phải bản địa đặt vào nơi cổ xưa này.

programme.title: DR ANN'S SECRET LIVES - SEA SNAKES

programme.title: DR KARL'S HOW THINGS WORK - ICE CREAM

programme.title: THE BUSINESS - BUDGET SPECIAL

programme.title: 10 ĐỐI 10 (MÙA 3) - 10 FIGHT 10 SEASON 3
programme.desc: Chương trình quy tụ các siêu sao, ca sĩ, võ sĩ, người mẫu và rapper Thái Lan vào sàn đấu quyền anh nổi tiếng. Phần 2 có trận đấu đầu tiên của nữ Thái Lan và Phần 3 có hai vận động viên giành huy chương vàng Thế vận hội cạnh tranh chức vô địch. Chương trình đấm bốc độc đáo này mang đến sự giải trí toàn diện, với các buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp, trang phục xa hoa và những trận chiến đẫm máu thực sự!

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn kể về bốn nam nhân vật nổi tiếng đến từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được đài thọ toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho các “anh em”!

programme.title: VÕ TÒNG BÁO THÙ - WUSONG VS XIMENQING
programme.desc: Ngô Song phát hiện ra chuyện chị dâu ngoại tình với một người đàn ông giàu có, Tây Môn Khánh. Qing gài bẫy Song và đày anh ta trong một năm, trong thời gian đó người anh trai kém may mắn của anh ta bị sát hại và hỏa táng. Cuối cùng, khi Song trở về nhà, anh đưa vụ án ra tòa nhưng thẩm phán gạt nó sang một bên và đột ngột đóng lại. Liệu Song cuối cùng có thể trả thù cho cái chết của anh trai mình?

programme.title: GIAO KÈO BÉO BỞ - A GOOD DEAL
programme.desc: Bị bắt cóc bởi một cặp vợ chồng tuyệt vọng, doanh nhân Burks Hill buộc phải thực hiện một hành trình điên cuồng đến Los Angeles. Khi nguy hiểm ngày càng gia tăng, ba du khách phát hiện ra rằng mỗi người họ đều ẩn chứa những bí mật chết người. Những gì bắt đầu từ một vụ bắt cóc đơn giản đã biến thành một trò chơi chết chóc mà không ai có thể sống sót.

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: TRUY TÌM BÍ DANH SỐ 0 - THE COMEBACK
programme.desc: Chú Hứa là một đặc vụ đã nghỉ hưu, chủ một cửa hàng đồ cổ trên phố cổ. Khi con phố cũ bị Green Dragon Gang địa phương buộc phải phá bỏ, danh tính ẩn giấu của Bác Hua vô tình bị tiết lộ và ông bị truy đuổi bởi một tổ chức bí ẩn do Ah Jie đứng đầu. Một cuộc đấu tay đôi chí mạng vừa mới bắt đầu!
